# Claude Code Templates - Agent Catalog

> Lean index of 1913 Claude Code components (agents, commands, skills, MCPs, hooks, settings, loops).
> Source: https://github.com/QB-Chen/claude-code-templates
> Official browse UI: https://aitmpl.com

## For coding agents

1. Fetch catalog JSON:
   - https://QB-Chen.github.io/claude-code-templates/catalog.json
2. Filter by type/tags/category; pick 1-3 components.
3. Install with the `install` field or read `readme_url` / `github_url`.

## Key URLs

- [Human site](https://QB-Chen.github.io/claude-code-templates/)
